test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A university uses a roll number system: COLLEGE(3) + YEAR(2) + STREAM(2) + SERIAL(4). If there are 150 colleges, 5 years of courses, 25 streams, how many students can be uniquely identified?
solution:
**Given:**

Number of Colleges = 150

Number of Years = 5

Number of Streams = 25

Serial Number Capacity (derived from options) = 100

Total Unique IDs = C × Y × S × Serial Capacity

⇒ Total = 150 × 5 &tim
